source.title: Key Indicators of Social Consumption in India: Health, NSS 75th round (July 2017 - June 2018)
source.publisher: National Statistical Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India

assumptions: A treated ailment draws on medicines similarly in government and private facilities; the survey counts treated spells, not medicine units.
Karnataka-wide shares applied to Gadag taluk, weighted by the taluk's own urban/rural population.
Charitable/NGO and informal providers are excluded; they are neither the government nor the private facilities on the map.
